About This Game

Demons Want Earth. Bad Idea.

Satan wants Earth. Unfortunately for him, you're ridiculously overpowered, the demons just keep coming, and you have a frankly unreasonable amount of firepower at your disposal.

Send Them to Hell is a chaotic 2.5D action roguelite where you slaughter massive demon hordes, build increasingly ridiculous combinations of upgrades, and see just how far you can push your power before everything on screen explodes.

Play solo or bring up to 3 friends along for the slaughter. Fight your way through hellish battlefields, discover powerful items, cast ultimate abilities, and turn yourself into a walking apocalypse.

Kill Demons. Break Your Build. Beat Your Friends' Scores. Repeat.

Fight Your Way Through Multiple Game Modes

Your mission in Adventure Mode is simple: survive five expanding biomes, grow stronger with every run, and take the fight straight to Satan himself.

But why stop there?

  • Adventure Mode - Battle through five biomes in a campaign that culminates in a showdown with Satan.

  • Endless - The hordes don't stop coming. How long can your build keep you alive?

  • Weekly Challenge - Take on a fresh challenge and compete for the highest score on the leaderboards.

  • The Fractured Earth - Descend through a floor-based dungeon where every run offers another chance to fight deeper and push further.

Bring Friends. Cause Problems.

Demons are a lot less intimidating when four heavily armed lunatics are mowing them down together.

Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op and turn the battlefield into an absolute disaster for Satan's army. Work together, stack your upgrades, and see what happens when everyone's builds start getting out of hand.

Of course, you can always compete for the high score afterward. Friendship is temporary. Leaderboards are forever.

Build Something Absurdly Powerful

Every run is another chance to discover a devastating combination of upgrades. With over 100+ items, unlockable Legendary Items, powerful Tomes, and a full Perk Tree, there are plenty of ways to turn an ordinary demon hunter into an extinction-level crusader.

Experiment with different upgrades. Unlock new abilities. Find combinations that make the hordes regret showing up.

And when a run ends? Take what you've earned, improve your character, and jump back into the slaughter even stronger than before.

Earth Isn't Going to Defend Itself

Satan made the first move. Now it's your turn. Send Them (back) to Hell.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

As of October 1, 2026

Our previous disclaimer disclosed the use of AI in drafting some of our original assets. As of October 1, 2026, thanks to the support of our early backers, the use of Aseprite and GIMP, and the work of talented freelance artists, all assets have been redrawn, rebuilt, and redesigned from their original versions, allowing us to move away from AI-generated artwork.

We will retain this disclaimer in the interest of complete transparency and to acknowledge the development process behind the game.

System Requirements

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-6300
    • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 460 / Radeon HD 5770 / Intel HD 4000 (OpenGL 3.3)
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2048 MB available space
    • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
    • Additional Notes: Requires an OpenGL 3.3 capable GPU. Java runtime is bundled. Internet connection required for online co-op only.
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2048 MB available space
    • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
    • Additional Notes: 1080p / 60+ FPS at High settings. Online co-op for 2–4 players over Steam.
